usage: bike-sim [-h] [--print-table] [--plot] [--plot-damper] [--export-json]
                [--export-mujoco] [--playground]
                [--output-plots-dir OUTPUT_PLOTS_DIR]
                [--output-models-dir OUTPUT_MODELS_DIR] [--all]

Bicycle Frame Geometry and Horst-Link Suspension Kinematics CLI Runner.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --print-table         Print formatted ASCII tables of uncompressed and
                        compressed hardpoint coordinates and geometry metrics.
  --plot                Generate 3 publication-quality kinematic and geometry
                        plots (PNG).
  --plot-damper         Generate publication-quality RockShox ZEB Ultimate &
                        Super Deluxe damper dyno curves.
  --export-json         Export all hardpoint coordinates and geometry metadata
                        to JSON.
  --export-mujoco       Export complete MuJoCo MJCF XML models.
  --playground          Launch interactive 2D MuJoCo suspension test stand
                        viewer.
  --output-plots-dir OUTPUT_PLOTS_DIR
                        Directory where plot images will be saved (default:
                        output/plots).
  --output-models-dir OUTPUT_MODELS_DIR
                        Directory where MJCF XML and JSON files will be saved
                        (default: output/models).
  --all                 Execute all operations: print tables, generate plots,
                        export JSON, and export MuJoCo models.
